summary: Conventional finite-element baseline for continuum PDEs and linear elasticity

Learned surrogate trained on separate conditions; unseen geometry/load/material holdout evaluated vs converged conventional solutions.

The source inspection is supplemented by a real STEP→Gmsh 4.13→SciPy three-resolution axial elasticity patch, including area, volume, reaction, energy and displacement. Repeat with Gmsh 4.15.2 / DOLFINx 0.11 and a non-affine convergence case.
